result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would work tirelessly to promote global literacy. Literacy empowers individuals, transforms communities, and fosters sustainable development. It opens doors to knowledge, skills, and opportunities that can break the cycle of poverty, reduce inequality, and promote social and economic progress.

Together with governments, non-profit organizations, and other stakeholders, I would focus on providing universal access to education, improving the quality of schooling, and ensuring that every girl and boy can read and write. By bridging the literacy gap, we can create a world where everyone has the tools to make informed decisions, participate in the global conversation, and positively impact their own lives and the world around them.
